---
title: ros init
description: Create a `deploy.yaml` in the current project.
icon: FilePlus
---

```bash
ros init [--force]
```

Generates a minimal `deploy.yaml` at the project root. If the file already
exists, `ros init` refuses to overwrite unless `--force` is passed.

## Examples

```bash
# Create a fresh deploy.yaml
ros init

# Overwrite an existing file
ros init --force
```

## Generated file

```yaml title="deploy.yaml"
version: "1"
name: "my-app"

deploy:
  tag: v0.1.0
  strategy: rolling

ssh:
  port: 22
  timeout: 60

environments:
  test:
    servers:
      - root@192.168.10.11
  staging:
    servers:
      - root@192.168.20.11
  production:
    servers:
      - root@192.168.30.11

pods:
  api:
    type: api
    driver: docker
    instances: 1
    containers:
      - name: api
        image: ghcr.io/myorg/api
        tag: v0.1.0
        ports: ["3001:3001"]
        healthcheck: /healthz
        restart: unless-stopped

proxy:
  routes:
    - domain: api.example.com
      upstream_port: 3001
      tls: auto
```
